_paper_reported.note: Numbers reported in the paper (arXiv 2507.12050), kept unchanged for context. Table 3: AdaFace-IResNet101 (WebFace12M) face verification/identification accuracy in percent; Tables 1-2: 1M-identity identification time/storage on the authors' i7-11700K with IPCL/HEaaN. The gym does not reproduce face images, the AdaFace backbone, IJB-C, or wall-clock HE timings, so none of these values are on the gym's scale or targets it must match.

synthetic_identification.description: Protected identification at the paper's (alpha, beta) = (341, 341) encrypted-cost operating point: at most 680 ciphertext additions per probe on average and at least 5 templates packed per 50-bit plaintext slot (codes of dimension <= 512). A run over budget fails.
synthetic_identification.notes: Scored synthetic benchmark (10,000 enrolled identities; 10,000 genuine and 20,000 impostor probes; 512-D unit templates with mixed probe quality). The hidden test draws a fresh benchmark of the same distribution from a seed held only by eval/test. Every method is run through its encoder on templates only; the evaluator computes scores, costs and metrics. Rows 'idface' and 'plain' hold the paper's Table 3 IJB-C identification TPIR (AdaFace-IResNet101) at the matching operating point, as fractions, for orientation only: the synthetic benchmark is not IJB-C. Its difficulty was set so the unprotected float-cosine context lies in the same high-accuracy regime as the paper's plain model; the protected rows were not tuned. Baseline rows without values have no paper counterpart.

tpir_at_fpir_0.01.description: Primary. Open-set true positive identification rate: fraction of genuine probes whose true identity is the strict unique top match and scores above the threshold at which 1% of impostor probes are falsely accepted (threshold set from the benchmark's own impostor probes).

tpir_at_fpir_0.001.description: Open-set TPIR at the stricter 0.1% false-positive identification rate.

tpir_at_fpir_0.1.description: Open-set TPIR at the looser 10% false-positive identification rate.

top1_identification.description: Closed-set rank-1 identification rate; ties with any wrong identity count as errors.

mean_reciprocal_rank.description: Mean reciprocal rank of the true identity; tied wrong identities rank ahead of it.

open_set_score_auc.description: Probability that a genuine probe's true-identity score exceeds an impostor probe's highest gallery score (ties count one half).

synthetic_identification_compressed.description: Protected identification at the paper's compressed (alpha, beta) = (341, 63) operating point: at most 124 ciphertext additions per probe on average and at least 8 templates packed per 50-bit plaintext slot (codes of dimension <= 512). A run over budget fails.
